meta.title: Robinson Crusoe: The Castaway's Journal | Text Adventure Survival Game
meta.description: Survive the island, one choice at a time. A text adventure survival game with a 10-chapter story, crafting, random events, and voyage ratings — in 13 languages.

hero.title: Robinson Crusoe: The Castaway's Journal
hero.tagline: Survive the island, one choice at a time.
hero.sub: A text adventure survival game across ten chapters. Every choice is written into your journal.
hero.imageAlt: Robinson Crusoe: The Castaway's Journal cover art

features.title: Features
features.lede: — Your voyage unfolds on pages of parchment —

story.title: A Ten-Chapter Story
story.body: Inspired by the classic novel — from shipwreck to rescue, ten chapters and dozens of choices shape your own survival story.

crafting.title: Backpack & Crafting
crafting.body: Salvage supplies, gather island materials, and craft the tools you need. Any item might be the one that keeps you alive.

events.title: Random Events
events.body: Storms, wild beasts, uninvited guests — no two voyages are alike. The same choice can lead to a very different fate.

ratings.title: Voyage Ratings
ratings.body: Earn an S-to-F voyage grade with a written review of your run. Browse your voyage log and chase the perfect escape.

playPreview.title: A Glimpse of Play
playPreview.lede: — Read, choose, and live with it —
playPreview.narrative: The waves hurl you onto an unfamiliar shore. Out among the reefs, the wreck of your ship drifts in and out of view as storm clouds gather. You are soaked through — but alive.

risky.label: Swim to the wreck at low tide and salvage supplies

safe.label: Search the shoreline for fresh water and food

danger.label: Head straight into the jungle to find a way out

languages.lede: — Read your adventure in your own words —

finalCta.body: Download for free and begin your castaway's journal.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy for Robinson Crusoe: The Castaway's Journal — game progress stays on your device; Google Mobile Ads may automatically process device and app data for rewarded advertising.
privacy.intro: In short: we do not operate a game account or game-progress server, and your saved progress stays on your device. The game uses Google Mobile Ads for optional rewarded ads. Its SDK may automatically collect and share device and app data for advertising, analytics, and fraud prevention, including when you are not watching an ad. Details and controls are below.

sections.heading: 1. Who this policy covers
paragraphs: This policy applies to the mobile game Robinson Crusoe: The Castaway's Journal (Android package identifier com.austronesiatw.robinsoncrusoe) and to this website, which presents the game.
Throughout this policy, “the app” means the mobile game and “the site” means this website.

sections.heading: 2. Information the game does not ask you to provide
paragraphs: The game has no account system or first-party game server. The game itself does not upload your saved game or voyage history. This section describes information we do not ask you to enter; Google Mobile Ads SDK data collection is described separately in section 4.
bullets: Names, email addresses, phone numbers, or any other contact details
User accounts, logins, or passwords — the game has no account system
Precise location, contacts, photos, camera, microphone, calendar, or files on your device
Payment or financial information — the game is free and contains no in-app purchases
Your saved game or voyage log — these never leave your device

sections.heading: 3. Data stored on your device
paragraphs: The app saves your progress locally so you can close the game and continue later. This data is written to your device's private application storage. It is never uploaded, and it is not readable by us or by the advertising provider.
Three pieces of information are stored:
bullets: Saved game: your current chapter, stamina, resources, backpack contents, and the choices you have made in the current run
Voyage log: a record of completed runs — score, grade, ending, duration, chapters completed, and final resources
Settings: your preferences, such as the interface language and whether in-game hints are shown

sections.heading: 4. Rewarded advertising
paragraphs: The game is free and is funded by rewarded advertising. Ads are never forced on you and never interrupt the story: an ad plays only when you actively choose to watch one in exchange for an in-game benefit — currently, reviving after a game over and restoring extra stamina. There are no banner ads and no interstitial ads. You can finish the entire game without watching a single ad.

Rewarded ads are delivered by {adProvider}, a third-party advertising service. Its SDK may automatically collect, process, and share the following data to deliver ads, support analytics, and prevent fraud, including when no ad is being watched:
bullets: Your device's advertising identifier — a resettable ID used to limit repeated ads and to measure ad performance
Your IP address, which may be used to estimate your general location
Product-interaction information, which may include app launches, taps, and video views
Diagnostics about app or SDK performance, such as launch time, hangs, or energy use
Device identifiers, which on Android may include the Advertising ID and App Set ID; other identifiers may apply depending on platform and configuration

sections.heading: 5. What we receive, and what we never do
paragraphs: The app does not send your saved game, voyage history, or an app-generated player profile to a server we operate. Google may provide us with aggregate advertising reports. Google and advertising partners may process SDK data under their applicable privacy terms; their roles and uses depend on the service and configuration.
We do not combine ad SDK data with your saved game or voyage history. Those game records remain on your device and are not uploaded by the game logic.
For Google's explanation of data use when third-party apps use Google services, see:

sections.heading: 6. Consent and your advertising choices
paragraphs: Where the advertising service requires a consent message, the app uses Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) to present the available ad privacy choices. You may decline personalized advertising where that choice is offered; the game remains fully playable, and some non-personalized or limited ads may still be available. Declining personalization does not stop all SDK data processing, such as technical delivery, frequency capping, measurement, or fraud prevention. UMP privacy options appear in the game menu when UMP reports that an entry point is required.

The iOS privacy statements in this policy are provisional: the iOS build is not release-ready. Before an iOS release, we will verify the production SDK, tracking behavior, consent controls, and App Store disclosures and update this policy.
Independently of the app, you can control the advertising identifier at the system level:
bullets: Android: Settings, then Privacy, then Ads — you can reset the advertising ID or delete it entirely
iOS: Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Tracking — you can switch off tracking requests for all apps
You can also simply not watch rewarded ads; they are entirely optional

sections.heading: 7. Network access
paragraphs: All story text, translations, images, and game data are bundled inside the app and loaded from local storage. The app does not download game content, and it does not contact any server operated by us — we operate none.

The app has no game-progress server. The Google Mobile Ads and UMP SDKs are initialized as the app starts and may make network requests for consent handling, ad delivery, analytics and measurement, and fraud prevention; data processing is not limited to the moment an ad is watched.

sections.heading: 8. Deleting your data
paragraphs: Uninstalling the app permanently deletes the saved game, the voyage log, and your settings from your device. Clearing the app's storage through your device's system settings has the same effect. We hold no server-side copy to delete, because none is ever created.

You can reset or delete your Android Advertising ID using your device's ad privacy settings, and you can change available ad privacy choices through UMP. These actions do not necessarily delete information already processed by Google or its ad partners. For provider-held data or privacy requests, use Google's privacy resources linked in section 5. We do not currently offer an in-app deletion control for advertising-provider records.

sections.heading: 9. This website
paragraphs: The site uses no cookies, no analytics, no tracking pixels, no advertising, and no third-party scripts. Nothing you do here is recorded by us.

The site is served through GitHub Pages. As with any web host, GitHub's servers may record technical request information such as your IP address and browser user agent in order to deliver the page and protect the service. That processing is governed by GitHub's own privacy statement.

sections.heading: 10. Children's privacy
paragraphs: The app's age audience and child-directed advertising configuration have not yet been finalized. Before distributing the app to an audience that includes children, we will verify the applicable requirements, configure ad requests accordingly, and update this policy.

We do not knowingly ask children to provide personal information. The advertising SDK may still process device or app data, so child-inclusive distribution requires a separate review of data collection and ad settings.
If you believe a child has provided personal information through the app, please contact us and we will act on it.

sections.heading: 11. Your rights
paragraphs: Privacy laws such as the GDPR and the CCPA give you rights to access, correct, export, or delete personal data held about you, to withdraw consent, and to object to your data being sold or shared.

We do not maintain a player account or server-side game profile. Advertising SDK data is processed by Google and, depending on ad delivery, its partners; we do not combine it with your local saved game.

For advertising data and available privacy rights, use Google's privacy resources linked in section 5 and your device's advertising controls. UMP privacy options are available from the game menu when the service requires that entry point. Our published contact address must be active before release so you can reach us with questions or requests.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If the app's data practices change, this policy will be updated before the change reaches users, and the date at the top of this page will be revised.

sections.heading: 13. Contact
paragraphs: If you have questions about this policy, please contact us at the address below.
